Independent_Turret_Eyes.description: Highly specialized, cone-shaped eyelids housing eyes that can rotate and focus entirely independently of one another. They grant simultaneous 360-degree stereoscopic vision, allowing unparalleled depth perception before a strike.

Lidded_Slit_Pupils.description: Vertical slit pupils protected by a transparent, unblinking spectacle scale (brille). Perfectly adapted for nocturnal hunting, these eyes regulate light precisely and are often paired with thermal-sensing pit organs.
